limitations: This is a five-record metadata-frame pilot, not a representative literature census.
The only structure-tagged group is protected, so the enriched pool has zero selected groups in this pilot; the mechanism remains ready for a larger frame.
The frame carries unknown reuse class and no journal/domain fields; these must be populated before a work-scale freeze.
The T030 fixture evaluation case is not identifier-linked to this T029-derived frame; the protected identifier closure must be reconciled against the actual final annotation manifest.
Runtime and storage estimates are planning limits until T041 measures real acquisition and processing costs.
open_decisions: Approve snapshot date, publication-year range, language/document-type policy and reuse class for the production frame.
Supply or build the work-host metadata census with journal/domain, version, structure and acquisition-size fields.
Choose final broad/enriched/release volumes and update the cost envelope from T041 measurements before T042.
